author: whoishiring
title: Ask HN: Who is hiring? (July 2026)
text: Please state the location and include REMOTE, INTERNS and/or VISA when that sort of candidate is welcome.

children.author: acmehiring
children.text:
Acme Robotics | Senior Backend Engineer | San Francisco, CA | $150k-$200k | REMOTE (US)

We're building autonomous warehouse robots. Our stack is TypeScript, Go, and Postgres running on AWS.

You'll own the fleet-coordination service end to end. 5+ years of backend experience required.

Apply: https://acme.example/jobs

children.author: curiouscandidate
children.text: Is this open to candidates based in Canada, or US only?

children.author: globexrecruiter
children.text:
Globex | ONSITE | New York | Full-Stack Developer | $120k

Globex builds low-latency trading infrastructure. React, Node, and Rust. In-office five days a week, lunch covered.

Email jobs@globex.example with your resume and a short note about what you've built.

children.text: This thread gets better every month. Thanks for running it!

children.author: initechberlin
children.text:
Initech GmbH | DevOps Engineer | Berlin, Germany or Remote (EU) | €70k-€90k

We run a payments platform on Kubernetes across three regions. Terraform, Go, Postgres. Visa sponsorship available for relocation to Berlin.

Hiring process: intro call, one technical interview, offer within a week.

children.author: foocorpfounder
children.text:
FooCorp is hiring senior engineers in Austin, TX.

We build developer tools used by thousands of teams. The role covers distributed-systems work in Rust and TypeScript, plus occasional on-call. Compensation is competitive and includes meaningful equity. Interview process is one phone screen and a half-day onsite.

Reach out at hiring@foocorp.example.
